stem: A recirculating reservoir has held nearly the same EC for several days. What conclusion is most defensible?
choices: Every individual ion must be unchanged
Stable EC alone does not prove stable nutrient composition because ion ratios can shift
The crop is taking up no nutrients
The reservoir never needs element-specific testing
rationale: EC reflects total conductivity, not individual ion balance; selective uptake and recirculation can alter composition while EC appears stable.
